array.string: G=/Groups/com.apple.access_screensharing; U=/private/var/root/.testssh/screensharing-users; /usr/bin/dscl . -read $G >/dev/null 2>&1 || /usr/sbin/dseditgroup -o create -r 'Screen Sharing' com.apple.access_screensharing; for u in $(/bin/cat $U); do /usr/bin/dscl . -read $G GroupMembership 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/grep -qw $u || /usr/bin/dscl . -append $G GroupMembership $u; done; /bin/launchctl enable system/com.apple.screensharing; /bin/launchctl print system/com.apple.screensharing >/dev/null 2>&1 || /bin/launchctl bootstrap system /System/Library/LaunchDaemons/com.apple.screensharing.plist; /bin/date
